story: Toronto led by 13 in the fourth and Scottie Barnes forced overtime. Brunson's corner three put New York ahead for good, 112–108.
aria: Animated Short: Jalen Brunson's corner 3-pointer off an inbounds pass with 33 seconds left in overtime that broke a 106–106 tie. Knicks win 112–108 in overtime. An original illustration, not traced from footage, not to scale.
